Adm. Kirk (William Shatner), Mr. Spock (Leonard Nimoy), Dr. McCoy (DeForest Kelley) and crew embark in the overhauled Enterprise to find an intelligent entity called VGER.
programme.title: Star Trek: The Motion Picture

programme.desc: The Southerner (Gene Tierney) and her husband (Randolph Scott) are still fighting the Civil War, chased by a Union major (Dana Andrews) smitten with Belle.
programme.title: Belle Starr

programme.desc: Shakespeare's king of England (Kenneth Branagh) attacks France and declares his love for the French king's daughter.
programme.title: Henry V

programme.desc: S05 E03 — Lucy, the Bean Queen Lucy accumulates cans of beans hoping to make a profit from them.
programme.title: The Lucy Show

programme.desc: Poor sharecroppers, the Joads leave dust bowl Oklahoma in hope of better luck in California.
programme.title: The Grapes of Wrath

programme.desc: Two vaudeville flops (Bing Crosby, Bob Hope) pose as bad guys and join the Klondike gold rush with a saloon singer (Dorothy Lamour).
programme.title: Road to Utopia

programme.desc: After the war with Mexico, cavalry officers try to steal land from Mexican peasants to establish their own empire.
programme.title: Raiders of Old California

programme.desc: A woman contemplating divorce from her husband recalls their early years together and the tragedies that ensued.
programme.title: Penny Serenade

programme.desc: A beautiful detective goes undercover to investigate a huge drug ring in Los Angeles.
programme.title: Get Christie Love!

programme.desc: An outlaw gets even with the Wells Fargo agent who put him in prison by making him the target of bounty hunters.
programme.title: Gunfight in Black Horse Canyon

programme.desc: A St. Louis lawyer's (Leon Ames) family (Judy Garland, Margaret O'Brien) stays in town for the 1904 World's Fair.
programme.title: Meet Me in St. Louis

programme.desc: A tracker (Sammy Davis Jr.) helps a white rancher (Ernest Borgnine) avenge his son and rescue his daughter.
programme.title: The Trackers

programme.desc: A time-warped astronaut (James Franciscus) lands on ape-ruled Earth and finds telepathic mutants worshiping an atomic bomb.
programme.title: Beneath the Planet of the Apes

programme.desc: A snooty socialite (Katharine Hepburn) fights with her ex-husband (Cary Grant) and flirts with a reporter (James Stewart).
programme.title: The Philadelphia Story

programme.desc: A butcher and a simpleton climb a magical beanstalk, seeking a giant and a hen that lays golden eggs.
programme.title: Jack and the Beanstalk

programme.desc: A real-estate man (Dwight Frye) visits the Transylvania castle of a 500-year-old vampire (Bela Lugosi).
programme.title: Dracula

programme.desc: The frontiersman (Bruce Bennett) leads settlers to Kentucky, where he makes peace with a Shawnee chief (Lon Chaney).
programme.title: Daniel Boone, Trail Blazer

programme.desc: For his fiancée's charity a stockbroker bets friends that for 24 hours he will tell only the truth.
programme.title: Nothing but the Truth

programme.desc: Supercomputer HAL 9000 guides astronauts (Keir Dullea, Gary Lockwood, William Sylvester) on a trip to find the origins of humans.
programme.title: 2001: A Space Odyssey

programme.desc: Sherlock Holmes (Basil Rathbone) and Dr. Watson (Nigel Bruce) prowl foggy moors to save Sir Henry (Richard Greene) from a killer-dog family curse.
programme.title: The Hound of the Baskervilles

programme.desc: A woman (Ann Sheridan) searches San Francisco for her husband, the hunted witness to a gangland execution.
programme.title: Woman on the Run

programme.desc: A lone frontiersman (James Stewart) risks his life to forge peace between Arizona settlers and Cochise's (Jeff Chandler) Apache nation.
programme.title: Broken Arrow

programme.desc: A clumsy young man nurtures a plant and discovers that it's carnivorous, forcing him to kill to feed it.
programme.title: The Little Shop of Horrors

programme.desc: An ace reporter's editor, her ex-husband, tries everything possible to stop her from remarrying someone else.
programme.title: His Girl Friday

programme.desc: A naughty little girl (Shirley Temple) dreams she and her brother are sent by a fairy to find the bluebird of happiness.
programme.title: The Blue Bird

programme.desc: Rock 'n' rollers (Chubby Checker, Gene Chandler, Vic Dana) put on a TV dance special.
programme.title: Don't Knock the Twist

programme.desc: An ambulance driver and a nurse share an ill-fated romance in World War I Italy. Based on Ernest Hemingway's novel.
programme.title: A Farewell to Arms

programme.desc: After being shot in a gunfight, Hopalong Cassidy sets out to settle the war between cattlemen who each accuse the other of stealing their livestock.
programme.title: Hopalong Cassidy Enters

programme.desc: A San Francisco playgirl (Tippi Hedren) follows a bachelor (Rod Taylor) to Bodega Bay where, for no apparent reason, flocks of birds begin killing the populace.
programme.title: The Birds

programme.desc: A barmaid, a Bostonian and an Indian (Rita Gam) flirt with an artist (Scott Brady) in 18th-century upstate New York.
programme.title: Mohawk

programme.desc: A spy and the FBI hunt a petty thief (Richard Widmark) who has lifted microfilm from a woman's (Jean Peters) purse.
programme.title: Pickup on South Street

programme.desc: Count Alucard comes out of a lake in his coffin and makes a Southern belle his bride.
programme.title: Son of Dracula

programme.desc: Dagwood (Arthur Lake) gets Blondie (Penny Singleton) a fur coat after his old girlfriend (Rita Hayworth) comes to town.
programme.title: Blondie on a Budget

programme.desc: A group of Allied soldiers are intent on breaking out, not only to escape, but also to draw Nazi forces away from battle to search for fugitives. Among the prisoners are American Captain Virgil Hilts and British Squadron Leader Roger Bartlett.
programme.title: The Great Escape

programme.desc: Slapstick comedy from Larry, Moe, Curly and occasionally Shemp.
programme.title: The Three Stooges

programme.title: Blondie

programme.desc: An eccentric pianist (Burgess Meredith) invades a couple's (Merle Oberon, Melvyn Douglas) home and marriage.
